summary_markdown:
The conversation focused on adding impression data for the traffic page, initially requested by someone. The requirement was clarified as needing to be included in a report rather than charts.

Regarding implementation, it was discussed whether STAGE data could be re-aggregated with impressions and then copied to PROD. Someone confirmed that while they would recalculate the data (starting from 01.12.23), transferring it to PROD at that time was not possible. Later, confirmation was exchanged regarding the successful upload of new data to STAGE.
decisions: The impression data needs to be added to the report for the traffic page.
action_items: Someone will recalculate and provide the updated data set (starting from 01.12.23).
